## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues, for example `Closes #123`.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results, including the OS tested. For Java changes, run `./mvnw verify` (Windows: `.\mvnw.cmd verify`). For packaging changes, also run `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests` (Windows: `python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests`). Explain any checks you could not run.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, include before/after screenshots or a recording. Otherwise, remove this section.

## Review notes

Mention relevant behavior changes, compatibility concerns, or follow-up work. Remove this section if unnecessary.

- [ ] Changes are focused and follow the existing project conventions.
- [ ] No API keys, saved credentials, or private information are included.
- [ ] Any live Steam testing is described, including whether achievements were changed.
